snippet.title: Shady Business Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Make lamps for villains!
As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

Wishlist on Steam! 🕯️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4694460/Shady_Business/

Bluesky:
https://bsky.app/profile/shadybusinessgame.bsky.social
Tumblr:
https://www.tumblr.com/blog/shadybusinessgame

A game by Tomboy Software funded by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg.

Music:
Won Jong Hwa (Fresh_Morning) - Letter From Brazil
